faq.title: Frequently asked questions about Cheki
faq.description: Everything you need to know to start selling products and services online with Cheki.

items.question: What is Cheki?
items.answer: Cheki is a platform that lets you sell products and services online simply. You publish your product with photos and price, and your customers can buy instantly, 24/7.

items.question: Do I need a physical store?
items.answer: Not at all. With Cheki you can sell from home, your phone, or wherever you are. Many of our successful sellers started without a physical location.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: Cheki accepts credit/debit card payments, bank transfers and cash. All payments are protected and secure.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Cheki has a free plan to get started. When you're ready to scale, we offer premium plans with more tools and features. No contracts or hidden costs.

items.question: How do I get support?
items.answer: Our support team is available via chat and email. We also have tutorials, guides and a community of sellers to help you.
